claims.summary: Characteristic zero, every M>=2, r=binom(M,2). The pair space of the cluster degeneration (eps*b_1..eps*b_M,s,t) converges to Phi0 = Pol_{<r} + (1+T)^(-3/2)Pol_{<M} + (1-T)^(-3/2)Pol_{<M} + <(1-T^2)^(-3/2)> (branch values normalized to -1,1). Its finite non-branch Weierstrass points are exactly the zeros of Q_r, defined by D^r(1-T^2)^(-3/2)=(1-T^2)^(-3/2-r)Q_r (recurrence Q_(k+1)=(2k+3)TQ_k+k(k+2)(1-T^2)Q_(k-1)), the degree-r polynomial solution of (T^2-1)Q''-(2r+1)TQ'+r(r+2)Q=0 (Gegenbauer with lambda=-r-1); each has weight exactly one.
claims.assessment: Working all-M proof after one fresh-context medium review: after D^r and a unit factor the space is Y + <Q_r> with Y invariant under the Gegenbauer operator G (eigenvalues j^2+j-3/4), and a spectral-projection hyperplane argument gives the weights.
claims.rationale: All-dimensional base case of a cluster-degeneration proof of generic Weierstrass-weight bounds needed for open statement 3.

claims.assessment: Finite check, exact over Q by interpolation with two verification points; independent control of the all-M theorem.
claims.rationale: Control for the binary-face Weierstrass theorem.
